one_line: Father and son at the heart of the House of Ganesha crisis in early 15th‑century northern Bengal.

appearance.age_look: Raja Ganesha appears as a sturdy man in his late 40s; Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah as a lean young ruler in his mid 20s.
appearance.face: Ganesha has a broad square face, medium‑brown Bengal complexion, strong jaw, thick brows, neatly trimmed moustache and a calm, calculating default gaze; Jalaluddin has an oval face, slightly lighter brown complexion, sharp nose, fine brows, thin moustache and a quietly intense, thoughtful default expression.
appearance.hair: Ganesha’s hair is black, tied back in a low bun under a deep red cloth turban with a simple gold band; Jalaluddin’s black hair is similarly tied in a low bun under a dark green, slightly taller Bengal‑style turban with a narrow gold band and a small white plume at the front.
appearance.costume: Raja Ganesha wears a full‑sleeved, knee‑length cotton jama in warm ivory, wrapped left over right, with a deep red silk patka (sash) tied at the waist, plain brown cotton churidar trousers, and a heavy, short gold necklace plus simple gold bangles; over this he has a muted dark maroon quilted cotton coat lightly padded at the shoulders, and brown leather shoes with softly upturned toes. Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah wears a full‑sleeved, slightly flared silk jama in rich deep green with subtle gold edging at the collar and cuffs, tied with a broad golden‑yellow sash knotted at his left hip, over light tan fitted cotton trousers; he has a long, finely woven cream shawl with narrow green and gold borders draped from his left shoulder across his torso, a slim gold chain with a small round pendant, and plain leather shoes dyed dark brown. Both outfits are era‑accurate Bengali court dress with modest coverage and no exposed torso.
appearance.signature: Raja Ganesha carries a sheathed curved Bengal‑style sword with a plain steel blade and simple brass hilt, hanging from his left hip on a red leather belt, while Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah carries a small rectangular leather document case in his left hand, symbolising his role as sultan managing multi‑religious administration and contested policies.

ref_desc: Raja Ganesha has a square‑faced, medium‑brown look with a red turban, ivory jama, maroon quilted coat and red‑belted curved sword, while Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah is a lean, oval‑faced youth in a green turban, green silk jama, cream shawl and brown shoes holding a document case.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of two fixed characters from early 15th‑century northern Bengal: Raja Ganesha is a sturdy late‑middle‑aged zamindar with a square face, medium‑brown complexion, strong jaw, thick brows and a neat moustache, wearing a deep red cloth turban with a simple gold band, a full‑sleeved knee‑length ivory cotton jama wrapped left over right, a deep red silk sash at his waist, plain brown churidar trousers, a short gold necklace, simple gold bangles, a muted dark maroon quilted cotton coat lightly padded at the shoulders, and brown leather shoes with soft upturned toes; at his left hip hangs his signature curved Bengal‑style sword in a plain sheath on a red leather belt. Beside him stands his son Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah, a lean young sultan with an oval face, slightly lighter brown complexion, sharp nose, fine brows and thin moustache, wearing a dark green slightly taller Bengal‑style turban with a narrow gold band and small white plume, a full‑sleeved flared deep green silk jama with subtle gold edging on collar and cuffs, a broad golden‑yellow sash knotted at his left hip, light tan fitted cotton trousers, and a long cream shawl with narrow green and gold borders draped from his left shoulder across his torso, along with a slim gold chain and dark brown leather shoes; his signature prop is a small rectangular leather document case held in his left hand. Show both characters front‑facing, clearly displaying their distinct faces, fixed hairstyles under turbans, historically grounded Bengali court garments, weapons and props, and the shared palette of deep red, dark green, ivory, maroon and golden yellow.
